sentence: This project builds an instrument that visualizes and measures single molecules to give researchers and clinicians higher quality information.
This project tests whether a health system program can get more people with high-risk colon polyps to have a repeat colonoscopy on time.
This project uses machine learning and single-cell profiling to study cells in hybrid cell states during the early invasion stage of the metastatic cascade.
This project builds a machine learning model to understand how phosphoranyl radicals split, and to extend phosphine catalysis to more complex transformations.
This project uses blood-based sequencing and imaging to predict which patients with non-small cell lung cancer will respond to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
This project measures muscle mass at home in postmenopausal women using the D3-creatine method, comparing cancer survivors with age-matched cancer-free controls.
This project tests how noninvasive retinal imaging can help explain the subtypes and outcomes of chronic kidney disease in people with diabetes and hypertension.
This project tests whether the antidiabetic drug sitagliptin can treat cutaneous capillary malformations, using in vitro and in vivo models.
This project develops a way to study the structure of disordered proteins, including mixtures of them, using solution and gas-phase approaches.
This project supports basic biomedical research on problems at the interface between physics, chemistry, engineering and biology.
This project studies how stress and executive function relate to alcohol use in people with alcohol use disorder, in laboratory and real-world settings.
This project uses genetics with other known factors to predict type 1 diabetes risk and pick people who will respond to therapies that prevent it.
This project tries to find which mutations in non-coding sequences drive multiple myeloma, using genetic-epigenetic mapping followed by functional assays.
This project builds molecular tools to control defined synaptic connections in brain circuits during behavior.
This project builds a toolbox and an experimentally validated process model for continuous production of monoclonal antibodies.
This project studies how immune cells and extra-cellular nanoparticles contribute to human systemic autoimmune diseases.
This project studies the role of metabolic-epigenetic crosstalk in pancreatic cancer and tests combinations of therapies.
This project provides analyses of glucose metabolism, mitochondrial function and intracellular signaling in rodent models and cells to support diabetes and obesity research.
This project develops a gene therapy vector that uses viral protein expression and viral genome maintaining mechanisms in tumors.
This project develops rapid MRI methods that replace complex imaging protocols with simple acquisitions and use machine learning for image reconstruction.
